apply_patch.en: Apply a unified diff; requires reading the same file first.
apply_patch.zh: 按 unified diff 打补丁；要求先 read_file 过同一个文件。

ask_user.en: Ask the user a question and wait for an answer — for when requirements are vague or a human choice is needed.
ask_user.zh: 向用户提问并等回答——用于需求含糊、需要人做选择时。

bash.en: Run shell commands, in a persistent session by default (cd and environment variables persist across turns).
bash.zh: 执行 shell 命令，默认走持久会话（cd、环境变量在轮次之间保留）。

bash_output.en: Read incremental output from a background command without waiting for it to finish.
bash_output.zh: 读取后台命令的增量输出，不必等它跑完。

browser_click.en: Click an element by the ref from a snapshot; when a ref is stale, have the agent take a new snapshot.
browser_click.zh: 按快照里的 ref 点击元素；ref 失效时让 Agent 重新 snapshot。

browser_navigate.en: Have the agent open an http(s) page, or go forward/back/reload; returns a page snapshot with refs.
browser_navigate.zh: 让 Agent 打开 http(s) 页面，或前进/后退/刷新，返回带 ref 的页面快照。

browser_screenshot.en: Capture the current page as PNG; the screenshot shows up in the trace as a tool result, and the thumbnail can be opened full-screen, zoomed, panned and downloaded. Requires attachment storage and an image model.
browser_screenshot.zh: 截当前页面为 PNG；截图会作为工具结果显示在轨迹中，可点缩略图全屏查看、缩放、拖动和下载。需要附件存储和图像模型。

browser_type.en: Fill an input by ref, optionally pressing Enter to submit.
browser_type.zh: 按 ref 填写输入框，可顺便回车提交。

build.en: Run one build with the given build command and return success/failure plus an error summary (the command is passed in by the caller).
build.zh: 在给定的构建命令下执行一次构建，返回成功/失败与错误摘要（命令由调用方传入）。

cancel_task.zh: 取消一个已排定的定时任务。

db_exec.en: Run writing SQL; only available when the host grants write permission.
db_exec.zh: 执行写 SQL；只有宿主授予写权限时才出现。

db_query.zh: 执行只读 SQL 查询。

edit_file.en: Modify a file by old/new text replacement; a forgiving match kicks in when the exact match fails.
edit_file.zh: 按 old/new 文本替换修改文件；精确匹配失败时有容错匹配。

git_commit.en: Commit the current changes as one commit.
git_commit.zh: 把当前改动提交为一个 commit。

git_diff.en: See the diff of the working tree or of a commit range.
git_diff.zh: 看工作区或某个提交范围的 diff。

git_push.en: Push the current branch to the remote.

git_status.en: See which files changed and how (structured status codes).
git_status.zh: 看哪些文件改了、怎么改的（结构化状态码）。

glob.en: Find files by filename pattern, sorted by modification time.
glob.zh: 按文件名模式找文件，按修改时间排序。

grep.en: Search file contents by regular expression, optionally limited by directory and file type.
grep.zh: 按正则搜文件内容，可限定目录与文件类型。

http_query.en: Send a custom HTTP request (method, headers and body can all be specified).
http_query.zh: 发一个自定义 HTTP 请求（方法、头、请求体都可指定）。

list_watches.en: List the currently registered file watches.
list_watches.zh: 列出当前已注册的文件监听。

lsp_definition.en: Jump to the definition of a symbol.
lsp_definition.zh: 跳到某个符号的定义位置。

lsp_diagnostics.en: Get the type / syntax errors reported by the language server.
lsp_diagnostics.zh: 取语言服务器报的类型 / 语法错误。

lsp_hover.en: See a symbol's type signature and documentation.
lsp_hover.zh: 看某个符号的类型签名与文档。

lsp_references.en: Find every place a symbol is referenced.
lsp_references.zh: 找出某个符号被引用的所有位置。

lsp_rename.en: Preview where a rename would make changes (nothing is written to disk).
lsp_rename.zh: 预览重命名会改哪些地方（不落盘）。

memory.en: Read and write long-term memory across sessions: search by keyword, write one memory.
memory.zh: 读写跨会话的长期记忆：按关键词检索、写入一条记忆。

multi_edit.en: Make several replacements in the same file, all or nothing.
multi_edit.zh: 对同一个文件做多处替换，要么全成要么全不改。

read_document.en: Read PDF / DOCX / XLSX / images and convert them to text.
read_document.zh: 读 PDF / DOCX / XLSX / 图片并转成文本。

read_file.en: Read a file (with line numbers); also reads images and PDF pages.
read_file.zh: 读文件（带行号）；也能读图片与 PDF 页面。

run_tests.en: Run the given test command, parse common test output and list the names of failing cases (the command is passed in by the caller).
run_tests.zh: 在给定的测试命令下执行，解析常见测试输出并列出失败的用例名（命令由调用方传入）。

schedule_task.en: Schedule a delayed task that wakes the session when it is due.
schedule_task.zh: 安排一个延时任务，到点后唤醒会话。

skill.en: Load the full instructions of a skill package.
skill.zh: 加载某个技能包的完整说明。

task.en: Dispatch a subagent for an independent subtask; if acceptance criteria are given they are judged on completion, and a failure triggers one automatic rework by default.
task.zh: 派一个子代理去干一件独立的子任务；写了验收标准就会在完成后判定，不达标默认自动返工一次。

task_output.en: Get the result of a subagent task.

todo_write.en: Maintain a todo list for the current task so progress is visible to both the human and the model.
todo_write.zh: 维护当前任务的待办清单，让进度对人和模型都可见。

watch_files.en: Watch files or directories for changes.
watch_files.zh: 监听文件或目录的变化。

web_fetch.en: Fetch the body text of a web page.

write_file.en: Create or fully overwrite a file; overwriting an existing file requires reading it first.
write_file.zh: 新建或整体覆盖一个文件；覆盖已存在的文件要求先 read_file。

browser_snapshot.en: Read the current page structure to get clickable/typable refs; prefer it for locating elements.
browser_snapshot.zh: 读当前页面结构，拿到可点击/可输入的 ref；优先用它定位元素。

browser_press_key.en: Press a key on the page or the focused element (Enter, Escape, Tab, arrow keys, etc.).
browser_press_key.zh: 在页面或焦点元素上按键（Enter、Escape、Tab、方向键等）。

browser_wait_for.en: Wait for some text to appear or wait a while, then return a fresh snapshot.
browser_wait_for.zh: 等某段文字出现或等一段时间，再回一份新快照。

browser_diagnostics.en: See recent console/page errors and failed/4xx/5xx requests, without response bodies.
browser_diagnostics.zh: 看最近的 console/page 错误和失败/4xx/5xx 请求，不含响应体。

browser_storage_state.en: Save the current login state (cookie/localStorage) to the configured path, for later sessions to reuse.
browser_storage_state.zh: 把当前登录态（cookie/localStorage）保存到配置的路径，供后续会话复用。
